ledger: 00:00: Initial state - Man facing camera. Background wall from viewer's left to right: Door edge, wall section with blue coat on hook, double door with glass panels, wall section with buzzer plate and picture frame, door edge.
00:06: Man turns to his right (viewer's left) and walks towards a door.

00:07: Second shot state - Man facing a solid wood double door. Wall section to the right of this door contains, from left to right: a complex buzzer panel, the blue coat on a hook, and the picture frame.

findings.description: The spatial arrangement of the room's features changes completely when the camera angle cuts. In the initial shot, the coat hook and the picture frame are separated by a double door, located on opposite sides of the man. In the second shot, after he turns, the coat hook, picture frame, and a buzzer panel are all located on the same continuous section of wall to the right of the door he is facing.
